channel.title: AI GridWatch — New Jersey data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for New Jersey, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Red Bank: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ban on data centers; council also called on NJ to impose statewide moratorium

item.title: Asbury Park: data center moratorium — Enacted
New Jersey (Fair Share Act): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Requires data centers to make 10-year commitments covering their fair share of grid infrastructure and community impacts

item.title: Cherry Hill: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance prohibiting data centers as a non-permitted use, unanimous; small server rooms for standalone businesses still allowed. Most populous municipality in Camden County

item.title: Medford: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance prohibiting data centers within town limits, unanimous. Preemptive — no proposals pending

item.title: Mansfield Township (Burlington Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance banning data centers as a named use category, unanimous. 27th NJ municipality to pass a local ban

item.title: Chesterfield: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ban on data centers in all zones, adopted alongside Mansfield Township

item.title: Berkeley Heights: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban on data centers in all zones, unanimous; followed debate over potential Nokia site conversion

item.title: East Brunswick: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Zoning ban on data centers in commercial, business and industrial districts advanced by council; hearing set for Aug 10

item.title: Waterford Township (Camden Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ban on data centers in all zoning districts; cited heightened concerns as a Pinelands Community

item.title: Plainfield: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Citywide ban across all zoning districts introduced by council; final vote scheduled Aug 10. Council rejected a weaker regulatory approach in May

item.title: North Plainfield: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Ordinance 26-10 banning data centers borough-wide, 6-0 first reading; second reading and public hearing pending

item.title: Summit: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance banning AI data centers (20+ MW or significant municipal water impact) and, separately, detention centers, passed the same night — the data-center ban is permanent zoning, not a time-limited pause, aimed partly at keeping one off the former Bristol Myers Squibb campus. Some residents say the ordinance's enforcement mechanism falls short.

item.title: Monroe Township (Gloucester Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Two ordinances banning data centers township-wide. Hexa Builders is suing for more than $300M in federal court — the test case for whether a small municipality can absorb the litigation risk of a ban

item.title: Phillipsburg: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 2026-08 prohibits data centers throughout the town; council is folding the ban into the master plan to harden it against challenge

item.title: Jersey City: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Ordinance 26-057 would bar data centers as the principal use of industrial land. Passed first reading and the planning board; final council vote set for Aug 19, 2026

item.title: Howell Township: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Ordinance reconfirming data centers as a prohibited use; public hearing and final vote set for Aug 18, 2026

item.title: Andover Township: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Township moved to ban AI data centers after a contentious public meeting; faces a suit from National Land Developers over a former airport site
